object: The line types, pens and fills of one structure symbol of a Stair that CreateStairs and ModifyStairs write (API_StairStructureSymbolData of API_StairType::structSymbData), for one structure type and view. Only the given fields are changed; GetDetailsOfElements reads them back in structureSymbols, with the same keys.
- `structureType` (string ("UnderStructure", "Stringer"), required): The structure the symbol is for: the structure under the stair or the stringers.
- `view` (StairSymbolView, required): The view the symbol is for (Unknown is refused).
- `visibleLineTypeId` (AttributeId): Line type of the visible structure lines: a line type of the project.
- `visibleLinePen` (integer): Pen of the visible structure lines.
- `hiddenLineTypeId` (AttributeId): Line type of the hidden structure lines: a line type of the project.
- `hiddenLinePen` (integer): Pen of the hidden structure lines.
- `visibleFillId` (AttributeId): Fill type of the visible structure: a fill type of the project.
- `visibleFillPen` (integer): Foreground pen of the visible structure fill.
- `visibleFillBackgroundPen` (integer): Background pen of the visible structure fill.
- `hiddenFillId` (AttributeId): Fill type of the hidden structure: a fill type of the project.
- `hiddenFillPen` (integer): Foreground pen of the hidden structure fill.
- `hiddenFillBackgroundPen` (integer): Background pen of the hidden structure fill.

### StairMonolithStructureSymbolSettings

object: The line types, pens and fills of one symbol of a Stair's monolithic structure that CreateStairs and ModifyStairs write (API_StairMonolithStructureSymbolData of API_StairType::monolithStructureSymbolData), for one view and visible or hidden part. Only the given fields are changed; GetDetailsOfElements reads them back in monolithStructureSymbols, with the same keys.
- `view` (StairSymbolView, required): The view the symbol is for (Unknown is refused).
- `part` (StairSymbolPart, required): The visible or the hidden part of the structure (Unknown is refused).
- `goingLineTypeId` (AttributeId): Line type of the going lines: a line type of the project.
- `goingLinePen` (integer): Pen of the going lines.
- `goingNosingLineTypeId` (AttributeId): Line type of the nosing lines: a line type of the project.
- `goingNosingLinePen` (integer): Pen of the nosing lines.
- `connectionLineTypeId` (AttributeId): Line type of the connection lines: a line type of the project.
- `connectionLinePen` (integer): Pen of the connection lines. Archicad keeps it equal to connectionDetailLinePen: when the two are given different, both are read back as connectionDetailLinePen, and the difference is reported as an error, so give them the same pen.
- `connectionDetailLineTypeId` (AttributeId): Line type of the connection lines on detail views: a line type of the project.
- `connectionDetailLinePen` (integer): Pen of the connection lines on detail views. Archicad also uses it as connectionLinePen (see there).
- `drainingFillId` (AttributeId): Fill type of the draining: a fill type of the project.
- `drainingFillPen` (integer): Foreground pen of the draining fill.
- `drainingFillBackgroundPen` (integer): Background pen of the draining fill.
- `contourLineTypeId` (AttributeId): Line type of the contour lines: a line type of the project.
- `contourLinePen` (integer): Pen of the contour lines.

### StairStructureVisibilitySettings

object: Which structure symbols of a Stair are shown on which of its relevant stories, for one view, that CreateStairs and ModifyStairs write (API_StairStructureComponentSettingsVisibility of API_StairType::structureVisibilityOnStories). Only the given fields of the given items are changed; GetDetailsOfElements reads them back in structureVisibilityOnStories, with the same keys.
- `view` (StairSymbolView, required): The view the visibility is for (Unknown is refused).
- `uniformSymbolRepresentationEnabled` (boolean): Whether one structure symbol representation is used on every story (Archicad's uniform symbol representation) instead of the settings per story range.
- `stories` (array of object): The visibility per story range relative to the stair's relevant stories (API_StairStructSymbRelevantStoriesID). Only the given story ranges are changed.
  - `relevantStories` (string ("AllStories", "BelowRelevant", "BottomRelevant", "MiddleRelevant", "TopRelevant", "AboveRelevant"), required): The story range: every story, the stories below the relevant stories, the bottom, middle and top relevant story, or the stories above them.
  - `structures` (array of object): Whether the lines of each structure are shown, per visible or hidden part. Only the given items are changed.
  - `fills` (array of object): Whether the fills of each structure type are shown, per visible or hidden part. Only the given items are changed.
  - `monolithParts` (array of object): Which parts of a monolithic structure are shown, per visible or hidden part. Only the given fields are changed.

### StairLayout

object: The floor plan or reflected ceiling plan display of a Stair's components (API_StairLayoutData).
- `visibility` (StoryVisibility, required)
- `isAutoOnStoryVisibility` (boolean, required)
- `storyVisibility` (string ("HomeStoryOnly", "HomeAndOneStoryUp", "HomeAndOneStoryDown", "HomeAndOneStoryUpAndDown", "OneStoryUp", "OneStoryDown", "AllStories", "AllRelevantStories", "AllRelevantAndOneStoryUp", "AllRelevantAndOneStoryDown", "Unknown"), required): The stories the stair is shown on.
- `gridTypeAbove` (StairGridType, required): The symbol shown on the stories above the stair's relevant stories.
- `gridTypeTop` (StairGridType, required): The symbol shown on the top relevant story.
- `gridTypeMiddle` (StairGridType, required): The symbol shown on the middle relevant stories.
- `gridTypeBottom` (StairGridType, required): The symbol shown on the bottom relevant story.
- `gridTypeBelow` (StairGridType, required): The symbol shown on the stories below the stair's relevant stories.
- `showWalkingLine` (boolean, required)
- `showNumbering` (boolean, required)
- `showUpDownText` (boolean, required)
- `showDescription` (boolean, required)
- `showStructure` (boolean, required)
- `breakLineAngleType` (string ("AngleToVertical", "AngleToHorizontal", "NumberOfGoings", "Unknown"), required)
- `breakLineAngle` (number, required): The angle of the break line, used when breakLineAngleType is AngleToVertical or AngleToHorizontal.
- `breakLineAngleNumberOfGoings` (integer, required): The number of goings the break line crosses, used when breakLineAngleType is NumberOfGoings.
- `breakLineDistance` (number, required): The gap of the break line.
- `breakLinePositionType` (string ("FloorPlanCutPlaneHeight", "CustomHeight", "AtNthRiser", "Unknown"), required)
- `upperBreakLineCustomPosition` (number, required): The height of the upper break line, used when breakLinePositionType is CustomHeight.
- `lowerBreakLineCustomPosition` (number, required): The height of the lower break line, used when breakLinePositionType is CustomHeight.
- `upperBreakLineNthRiserPosition` (integer, required): The riser of the upper break line, used when breakLinePositionType is AtNthRiser.
- `lowerBreakLineNthRiserPosition` (integer, required): The riser of the lower break line, used when breakLinePositionType is AtNthRiser.
- `overrideLineType` (boolean, required): Whether lineTypeId overrides the line types of the stair's components.
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeId): The override line type; left out when not set.
- `overridePen` (boolean, required): Whether pen overrides the line pens of the stair's components.
- `pen` (integer, required)
- `overrideSymbolFill` (boolean, required): Whether symbolFillId and its pens override the symbol fills of the stair's components.
- `symbolFillId` (AttributeId): The override symbol fill type; left out when not set.
- `symbolFillPen` (integer, required)
- `symbolFillBackgroundPen` (integer, required)

### StairGridType

string ("NotRelevant", "WithSingleBreaklineFull", "NoBreaklineFull", "BelowBreakline", "AboveBreakline", "MiddleBreakline", "MiddleBreaklineFull", "NoBreakMarkHidden", "AboveBreakMarkHidden", "BelowBreakMarkHidden", "Multistory2DAllVisible", "Multistory2DHiddenVisible", ...): How a stair's symbol is drawn on a story (API_StairGridTypeID).

### SectionDetails

object: The geometry of a Section (CutPlane) or Elevation marker on the floor plan; for sections the fields CreateSections takes. Archicad stores both the same way.
- `name` (string, required): The name of the section or elevation.
- `idStr` (string, required): The reference ID of the section or elevation.
- `mainCoordinates` (array of Coordinate2D, required): The points of the section or elevation line, from start to end. More than two for a broken section line. Empty when the line cannot be read.
- `depthCoordinates` (array of Coordinate2D, required): The points of the depth line, the far boundary of the section or elevation. Empty when it cannot be read.
- `startCoordinate` (Coordinate2D): The first point of the section or elevation line (startCoordinate of CreateSections).
- `endCoordinate` (Coordinate2D): The last point of the section or elevation line (endCoordinate of CreateSections).
- `depth` (number): The distance of the first depth point from the first segment of the section or elevation line (depth of CreateSections).
- `viewDirection` (Coordinate2D): The unit vector perpendicular to the first segment of the section or elevation line, pointing to the side of the depth line: the direction the section or elevation looks in. CreateSections puts it to the left of the start to end direction.

### InteriorElevationDetails

object: The settings of an Interior Elevation element and its segments. Each segment is one viewpoint of the Project Map, with its own name, reference ID, lines and settings.
- `showOnStories` (string ("All", "OneStory", "InRange", "PartRange")): Which stories the interior elevation is shown on.
- `storyToShowOn` (integer): The story index the interior elevation is shown on, if showOnStories is 'OneStory'.
- `useCommonMarker` (boolean, required): Whether the common marker of the interior elevation is shown.
- `commonMarkerGuid` (Guid): The GUID Archicad keeps for the common marker (API_InteriorElevationType::markerGuid).
- `commonMarkerPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the common marker.
- `commonMarkerFontIndex` (integer): Font index of the common marker.
- `commonMarkerSize` (number): Size of the common marker.
- `commonMarkerTextSize` (number): Size of the common marker's text.
- `segments` (array of InteriorElevationSegmentDetails, required): The segments of the interior elevation, in the order of its line (CreateInteriorElevations makes one per gap between two nodeCoordinates). Empty when they cannot be read.

### InteriorElevationSegmentDetails

object: One segment of an Interior Elevation: one viewpoint of the Project Map.
- `name` (string, required): The name of the segment, shown in the Project Map. RenameNavigatorItem changes it through the segment's viewpoint.
- `idStr` (string, required): The reference ID of the segment, shown in its marker and in the Project Map.
- `mainCoordinates` (array of Coordinate2D, required): The points of the segment's line, from start to end. Empty when the line cannot be read. Archicad does not keep the line on the nodeCoordinates given to CreateInteriorElevations: in Archicad 26 and 28 each segment's line is moved to the left of its pair of nodes by the depth.
- `depthCoordinates` (array of Coordinate2D, required): The points of the segment's depth line, its far boundary. Empty when it cannot be read.
- `startCoordinate` (Coordinate2D): The first point of the segment's line.
- `endCoordinate` (Coordinate2D): The last point of the segment's line.
- `depth` (number): The distance of the first depth point from the first line of the segment (depth of CreateInteriorElevations).
- `viewDirection` (Coordinate2D): The unit vector perpendicular to the first line of the segment, pointing to the side of the depth line: the direction the segment looks in.
- `settings` (SectionElevationDetails, required): The settings of the segment (API_SectionSegment), with the keys GetSectionsAndElevationsDetails gives for a Section or an Elevation. showOnStories and storyToShowOn are the interior elevation's own, above, and markerShowType is not given.

### PictureAnchorPoint

string ("TopLeft", "TopCenter", "TopRight", "MiddleLeft", "Center", "MiddleRight", "BottomLeft", "BottomCenter", "BottomRight"): The anchor point of the picture on a 3x3 grid of its box (API_PictureType::anchorPoint).

### PictureDetails

object: The settings of a Picture element (an image placed with the Picture tool on a floor plan, worksheet, detail or layout).
- `name` (string, required): The name of the picture (API_PictureType::pictName), usually the name of the image file it was placed from.
- `mimeType` (string, required): The MIME type of the image, e.g. image/png or image/jpeg. Empty when Archicad does not report it.
- `box` (BoundingBox2D, required): The box the picture is drawn in, in model units, before its rotation by angle. For an unmirrored picture this is API_PictureType::destBox; a mirrored picture is drawn one width away from its stored destBox (along the rotated x axis), and this box is the drawn one, so a mirrored and an unmirrored picture drawn at the same place report the same box.
- `position` (Coordinate2D): Where the anchor point of the picture is, the point it is rotated around, in model units (on a layout in layout units): the anchorPoint of its box, worked out the way ModifyPictures places it, so ModifyPictures takes it back with the same key and the picture stays where it is. For an unmirrored picture it is the anchorPoint of box; for a mirrored one it follows ModifyPictures, which shifts the stored box by one width along x without the rotation.
- `width` (number, required): The width of the picture in model units: box.xMax - box.xMin.
- `height` (number, required): The height of the picture in model units: box.yMax - box.yMin.
- `pixelWidth` (integer, required): The width of the image in pixels.
- `pixelHeight` (integer, required): The height of the image in pixels.
- `angle` (number, required): The rotation angle of the picture in radians.
- `mirrored` (boolean, required): Whether the picture is mirrored to its local vertical axis.
- `transparent` (boolean, required): Whether the white pixels of the picture are drawn transparent.
- `anchorPoint` (PictureAnchorPoint, required)

### NotYetSupportedElementTypeDetails

object
- `error` (string, required)

### TypeSpecificDetails

HotlinkDetails or WallDetails or BeamDetails or SlabDetails or RoofDetails or ShellDetails or ColumnDetails or ColumnSegmentDetails or BeamSegmentDetails or DetailWorksheetDetails or WindowDoorDetails or SkylightDetails or LibPartBasedElementDetails or ObjectDetails or PolylineDetails or ZoneDetails or RailingDetails or RailingPostDetails or RailingInnerPostDetails or RailingRailDetails or RailingBalusterDetails or RailingBalusterSetDetails or RailingPanelDetails or RailingPatternDetails or RailingRailEndDetails or RailingRailConnectionDetails or RailingEndFinishDetails or CurtainWallDetails or CurtainWallSegmentDetails or CurtainWallPanelDetails or CurtainWallFrameDetails or CurtainWallJunctionDetails or CurtainWallAccessoryDetails or MeshDetails or MorphDetails or DrawingDetails or LabelDetails or TextDetails or LevelDimensionDetails or AngleDimensionDetails or DimensionDetails or RadialDimensionDetails or ChangeMarkerDetails or StairDetails or StairTreadDetails or StairRiserDetails or StairStructureDetails or SectionDetails or InteriorElevationDetails or PictureDetails or NotYetSupportedElementTypeDetails: Represents the complete type-specific details of an element. Used as output from GET requests

### ElementDetailsField

string ("elementId", "type", "id", "floorIndex", "layerIndex", "drawIndex", "details", "floorPlanPolygons", "hotlinkId"): A field of the details of an element.

### ElementDetailsAdditionalField

string ("infoString", "compoundInfoString", "libraryPartUnId", "creatorToolUnId"): An extra field of the details of an element, returned only when requested.

### RoofLevel

any or any: A level of a multi-plane roof: its height and the angle of the roof planes above it. Give levelHeight and levelAngle, or height and angle, the keys GetDetailsOfElements reads the levels with (RoofDetailsLevel), so the levels read can be sent back; levelHeight and levelAngle win when both forms are given.
- `levelHeight` (number)
- `levelAngle` (number)
- `height` (number): The same as levelHeight, as GetDetailsOfElements reads it.
- `angle` (number): The same as levelAngle, as GetDetailsOfElements reads it.

### RoofPivotLine

object: A directed pivot line defined by its beginning and end coordinates. The roof plane rises on the left side of the line direction (begCoordinate towards endCoordinate); reverse the direction to tilt towards the other side.
- `begCoordinate` (Coordinate2D, required)
- `endCoordinate` (Coordinate2D, required)

### RoofPivotEdgeChange

object
- `levels` (array of object): The roof plane of the edge on each level, from the pivot polygon upwards; at most as many as the roof has levels.
  - `angle` (number): Angle of the plane to the XY plane.
  - `eavesOverhang` (number): Extension of the eaves outside the pivot polygon.
  - `angleType` (string ("Sloped", "Gable")): Gable for a vertical gable plane, Sloped otherwise.
  - `topMaterialId` (AttributeId): The plane's own top surface (Custom Plane Settings). The roof is read back after the change, and the item fails if Archicad did not apply it (CreateRoofs then does not create the roof).
  - `bottomMaterialId` (AttributeId): The plane's own bottom surface (Custom Plane Settings). Read back like topMaterialId.
  - `coverFillId` (AttributeId): The plane's own cover fill (Custom Plane Settings). Read back like topMaterialId.

### RoofDetailsLevel

object
- `height` (number, required)
- `angle` (number, required)

### BoundingBox2D

object: A two-dimensional bounding box defined by its minimum and maximum coordinates.
- `xMin` (number, required)
- `yMin` (number, required)
- `xMax` (number, required)
- `yMax` (number, required)

### RoofDetailsPivotLine

object: The pivot line about which a roof plane rotates.
- `begin` (Coordinate2D, required)
- `end` (Coordinate2D, required)

### AutomaticZoneGeometry

object: Automatic zone placement.
- `referencePosition` (Coordinate2D, required): Reference point to automatically find zone.

### ManualZoneGeometry

object: Manual zone placement.
- `polygonCoordinates` (array of Coordinate2D, required): The 2D coordinates of the edge of the zone.
- `polygonArcs` (array of PolyArc): Polygon outline arcs of the zone.
- `holes` (Holes2D)

### ZoneCreationGeometry

AutomaticZoneGeometry or ManualZoneGeometry: Defines the geometry of a zone. Used as input for creating zones.

### WallSettings

object: Settings for modifying a wall.
- `begCoordinate` (Coordinate2D)
- `endCoordinate` (Coordinate2D)
- `height` (number): height relative to bottom
- `bottomOffset` (number): base level of the wall relative to the floor level
- `offset` (number): wall's base line's offset from ref. line
- `begThickness` (number): Thickness at the beginning in case of trapezoid wall
- `endThickness` (number): Thickness at the end in case of trapezoid wall

### ZoneSettings

object: Settings for modifying a zone. Only the given fields are changed, the polygon is kept. Set height and bottomOffset with ModifyZones: in SetDetailsOfElements they would make a wall's settings ambiguous.
- `name` (string): Name of the zone.
- `numberStr` (string): Zone number.
- `categoryAttributeId` (AttributeId): The identifier of the zone category attribute.
- `stampPosition` (Coordinate2D): Position of the origin of the zone stamp.
- `stampAngle` (number): Rotation angle of the zone stamp in radians.
- `fixedStampAngle` (boolean): If true, the zone stamp angle remains fixed when the element is rotated.
- `topOffset` (number): Offset of the top of the zone from the linked top story level. Only has an effect when relativeTopStory is non-zero.
- `relativeTopStory` (number): Non-zero links the top of the zone to another story, relative to its home story (1 is the story above), instead of an explicit height. Do not set together with height (ModifyZones) in the same call: whichever is applied last wins.
- `floorThickness` (number): Thickness of the floor finish (subfloor thickness) of the zone.
- `roomLSize` (number): Letter size of the zone (roomLSize of the Archicad API) in millimetres, not in metres like the other lengths. The zone stamps of the current Archicad libraries size their texts with their own parameters (GetGDLParametersOfElements, SetGDLParametersOfElements), so this value may not change how the stamp looks.
- `referencePosition` (Coordinate2D): Moves the reference point of an automatic zone; the zone is found around the new point when zones are next updated. Ignored for a manual zone (isManual true).
- `contourLine` (ZoneContourLine)
- `coverFill` (ZoneCoverFill)
- `surface` (ZoneSurface)
- `polygonDisplay` (ZonePolygonDisplay)
- `stampPen` (ZoneStampPen)
- `reducePercent` (ZoneReducePercent)

### ZoneContourLine

object: The contour line of a zone on the floor plan. GetDetailsOfElements returns every field; when setting, only the given fields are changed.
- `use` (boolean): Whether the contour line is drawn.
- `pen` (integer): The pen index of the contour line.
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeId): The line type attribute of the contour line.

### ZoneCoverFill

object: The cover fill of a zone on the floor plan. GetDetailsOfElements returns every field; when setting, only the given fields are changed.
- `use` (boolean): Whether the cover fill is drawn.
- `fillId` (AttributeId): The fill attribute of the cover fill.
- `foregroundPen` (integer): The pen index of the fill pattern.
- `backgroundPen` (integer): The pen index of the fill background. 0 is a transparent background; -1 also occurs in projects and is accepted, so a value read with GetDetailsOfElements can always be written back.
- `use3DHatching` (boolean): "Use the fill of the surface": true draws the cover fill with the vectorial 3D hatch of the zone's top surface instead of fillId.
- `useLocalOrigo` (boolean): The orientation of the cover fill. true: the fill is linked to the zone (rotated), starting at locOrigo in the direction of fillAngle. false: the fill is linked to the project origin and is not rotated.
- `locOrigo` (Coordinate2D): The origin of the cover fill when useLocalOrigo is true.
- `fillAngle` (number): The angle of the cover fill when useLocalOrigo is true, in radians.

### ZoneSurface

object: The 3D surface of a zone (the Model panel of the Zone Settings dialog). GetDetailsOfElements returns every field; when setting, only the given fields are changed.
- `surfaceId` (AttributeId): The surface attribute of the zone's 3D body: of all its sides when useOnAllSides is true, otherwise of the sides that do not inherit a surface from a bounding element.
- `useOnAllSides` (boolean): true: surfaceId is used on all sides of the zone. false: the sides inherit the surfaces of the bounding walls and trimming elements.

### ZonePolygonDisplay

string ("Gross", "Net"): The zone polygon display of the Zone settings: Gross uses the reference line of the bounding walls, Net their inner edges. Archicad only uses it for a zone whose boundary is the reference line of the walls (boundaryMethod ReferenceLine in GetDetailsOfElements); for other zones it is stored but has no effect.

### ZoneStampPen

object: The pen of the zone stamp. GetDetailsOfElements returns every field; when setting, only the given fields are changed.
- `uniform` (boolean): Uniform stamp pen: true draws the whole stamp with pen, false uses the pens defined in the zone stamp (category) library part.
- `pen` (integer): The pen index of the zone stamp. Only used when uniform is true.

### ZoneReducePercent

number: Reduces the calculated area of the zone by this percentage ("reduce area by %" of the Zone settings). 0 means no reduction.

### LineSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Line.
- `begCoordinate` (Coordinate2D)
- `endCoordinate` (Coordinate2D)
- `roomSeparator` (boolean)
- `linePenIndex` (integer)
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeId)
- `startArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the start. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `endArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the end. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `linkedArrowAttributes` (LinkedArrowAttributes): Optional: link (true) or unlink (false) the size and pen of the two arrowheads.

### ArcSettings

object: Settings for modifying an Arc or Circle. begAngle/endAngle are only applied to Arc, ignored for Circle. startArrow/endArrow are only for Arc: a Circle has no ends and refuses them.
- `origin` (Coordinate2D)
- `radius` (number)
- `angle` (number)
- `ratio` (number)
- `begAngle` (number)
- `endAngle` (number)
- `reflected` (boolean)
- `roomSeparator` (boolean)
- `linePenIndex` (integer)
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeId)
- `startArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the start of an Arc. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `endArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the end of an Arc. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `linkedArrowAttributes` (LinkedArrowAttributes): Optional: link (true) or unlink (false) the size and pen of the two arrowheads of an Arc. A Circle refuses it.

### HotspotSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Hotspot.
- `position` (Coordinate2D)
- `height` (number)
- `penIndex` (integer)

### SplineSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Spline. Only these settings fields are modifiable - Archicad's own API does not support changing Spline geometry (coordinates/closed) via ACAPI_Element_Change. Any other field (such as coordinates) fails the item with an error and changes nothing of it; delete the spline and create it again with CreateSplines to change its geometry.
- `roomSeparator` (boolean)
- `linePenIndex` (integer)
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeId)
- `startArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the start. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `endArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the end. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `linkedArrowAttributes` (LinkedArrowAttributes): Optional: link (true) or unlink (false) the size and pen of the two arrowheads.

### PolylineSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Polyline. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (single contour, no holes) and may change the number of vertices.
- `coordinates` (array of Coordinate2D)
- `arcs` (array of PolyArc)
- `roomSeparator` (boolean)
- `linePenIndex` (integer)
- `lineTypeId` (AttributeId)
- `drawSegmentMode` (PolylineDrawSegmentMode)
- `startArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the start. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `endArrow` (LineArrowhead): Optional arrowhead at the end. Given, it is shown unless its visible is false; only the keys given are changed.
- `linkedArrowAttributes` (LinkedArrowAttributes): Optional: link (true) or unlink (false) the size and pen of the two arrowheads.

### HatchSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Hatch. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (outline plus optional holes) and may change the number of vertices.
- `coordinates` (array of Coordinate2D)
- `arcs` (array of PolyArc)
- `holes` (Holes2D)
- `contourPenIndex` (integer): Pen of the contour; 0 switches the contour off, a pen switches it on.
- `contourLineTypeId` (AttributeId): The line type of the contour.
- `fillPenIndex` (integer): Setting a pen removes the foregroundColor override, so the pen shows.
- `fillBackgroundPenIndex` (integer): Pen of the fill background; 0 makes the background transparent and -1 gives it the window background color. Setting a pen removes the backgroundColor override, so the pen shows.
- `foregroundColor` (ColorRGB): RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill foreground, used instead of fillPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillPenIndex when both are given.
- `backgroundColor` (ColorRGB): RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill background, used instead of fillBackgroundPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillBackgroundPenIndex when both are given.
- `fillId` (AttributeId)
- `buildingMaterialId` (AttributeId)
- `roomSpecial` (integer): The percentage (1 to 100) of the hatch's area subtracted from the area of the zone it lies in (Subtract from zone area); a negative value switches it off.
- `showArea` (boolean)
- `fillOrientation` (HatchOrientation): Orientation, origin and distortion of the fill pattern. Omitted properties keep their current values. A given origin detaches the fill from the project origin, and a Global fill becomes Rotated unless a type is given as well. Archicad ignores the orientation of Solid fills (there is no pattern to orient).
- `fillCategory` (HatchFillCategory)

### DrawingSettings

object: Modifiable settings for a Drawing element placed on a layout.
- `pos` (Coordinate2D): Position of the drawing on the layout, in meters. Without a clip polygon it is the lower left corner of the drawing (before rotation); with one it is where the origin of the source view lands (a modelOffset can move it by modelOffset * drawingScale).
- `angle` (number): Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.
- `ratio` (number): Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.
- `drawingScale` (number): The nominal scale of the drawing. Archicad may keep the existing value of a placed Drawing; the element's execution result is then a failure that names the value kept, although the other settings given were applied.
- `modelOffset` (Coordinate2D): Offset of the model origin within the drawing, in model meters. Used only by clipped drawings; Archicad then adds modelOffset * drawingScale (times ratio, rotated by angle) to pos.
- `isCutWithFrame` (boolean): Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon. Set to false to clear an existing crop and restore the drawing's full auto-fit extent. Only consulted when no clipPolygon is supplied in the same call - supplying a clipPolygon always enables clipping. Setting it to true without a clipPolygon merely re-enables the clip polygon already stored on the Drawing.
- `clipPolygon` (array of Coordinate2D): Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). It is stored as given: pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it, so a polygon taken from the model must be transformed to the layout first. At least 3 points. Setting this also enables polygon clipping (isCutWithFrame becomes true); to remove clipping, set isCutWithFrame to false instead.
- `nameType` (DrawingNameType)
- `customName` (string): The drawing's custom title name. Only used when nameType is CustomName.
- `numberingType` (DrawingNumberingType)
- `customNumber` (string): The drawing's custom title ID. Only used when numberingType is CustomNumber.
- `isInNumbering` (boolean): Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.
- `isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex` (boolean): The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes. Set it to false on e.g. a 1:1 schedule drawing placed next to a 1:200 plan so that the layout's scale Autotext shows only 1:200.
- `hasBorderLine` (boolean): Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).
- `borderLineTypeIndex` (integer): Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.
- `borderPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the drawing's border.
- `borderSize` (number): Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.
- `titleLibraryPartIndex` (number): Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.
- `penTableUsageMode` (DrawingPenTableUsageMode)
- `penTableIndex` (integer): Attribute index of the pen set the drawing uses (API_DrawingType::penTableIndex). Archicad uses it only when penTableUsageMode is PenTableIndex; give both to switch the drawing to a pen set.
- `colorMode` (DrawingColorMode)
- `isTransparentBackground` (boolean): Whether the drawing's background is transparent (API_DrawingType::isTransparentBk).
- `rasterizeDPI` (number): The resolution, in dots per inch, a PDF drawing is rasterized at (API_DrawingType::rasterizeDPI).
- `anchorPoint` (DrawingAnchorPoint)
- `useOwnOriginAsAnchor` (boolean): Whether the drawing is placed by its own origin instead of anchorPoint (API_DrawingType::useOwnOrigoAsAnchor).

### TextSettings

object: Settings for modifying a Text element or a text-type Label. For Labels only the text field is applied. Setting text replaces the whole content (any per-run formatting of the old content is dropped) and switches the element to automatic width, matching the behavior of CreateTexts/CreateLabels.
- `text` (string): The new text content. Newlines create multiple lines; Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.
- `position` (Coordinate2D): The placement position of the text. Only applied to Text elements.
- `angle` (number): The rotation angle in radians. Only applied to Text elements.
- `height` (number): The character height in millimeters. Only applied to Text elements. A multistyle Text takes its height from the per-run sizes of its content, so applying it rebuilds the content (one paragraph per line) with the new height on every run (the runs' own pens/fonts/faces are kept) and switches the element to automatic width, as setting text does. Refused when the content holds an autotext run; give the new content explicitly via text then, or use ModifyTexts.
- `justification` (Justification): Only applied to Text elements.

### TypeSpecificSettings

WallSettings or ZoneSettings or LineSettings or ArcSettings or HotspotSettings or SplineSettings or PolylineSettings or HatchSettings or DrawingSettings or TextSettings: Defines the modifiable type-specific settings for an element. Used as input for SET requests.

### ZoneBoundariesWrapper

object
- `zoneBoundaries` (array of object, required)
  - `connectedElementId` (ElementId, required): The unique identifier of the connected element.
  - `isExternal` (boolean, required): True if the boundary is an external one.
  - `neighbouringZoneElementId` (ElementId, required): Returns the unique identifier of the other Zone the element connects to if the boundary is internal. Please note that this boundary does not represent the boundary of the element with the other Zone.
  - `area` (number, required): The area of the polygon of the boundary.
  - `polygonOutline` (array of Coordinate3D, required): The outline polygon of the boundary.

### ZoneBoundariesOrError

ZoneBoundariesWrapper or ErrorItem: The response of the zone boundaries command or an error.

### ZoneBoundariesOfZonesWrapper

object
- `zoneBoundariesOfZones` (array of ZoneBoundariesOrError, required): The boundaries of each requested Zone, in the same order as the zones array of the input.

### ElementsWithExecutionResults

object: The response of the GetElementsByType command.
- `elements` (Elements, required)
- `executionResultForDatabases` (ExecutionResults)

### ElementsWithExecutionResultsOrError

ElementsWithExecutionResults or ErrorItem: The response of the GetElementsByType command or an error.

### ConnectedElementsWrapper

object: The response of the GetConnectedElements command.
- `connectedElements` (array of object, required)
  - `elements` (Elements, required)

### ConnectedElementsOrError

ConnectedElementsWrapper or ErrorItem: The response of the GetConnectedElements command or an error.

### DimensionData

object: Dimension element data including witness points and geometry.
- `elementId` (ElementId)
- `direction` (Coordinate2D)
- `dimensionLinePosition` (Coordinate2D)
- `appearance` (string ("Linear", "Cumulative", "Baseline", "Elevation")): The dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings.
- `elevationOrigin` (DimensionOrigin): The level an Elevation dimension measures from (kept for the other types too).
- `elevationMarker` (DimensionElevationMarker): The marker of an Elevation dimension, always with all of its fields (kept for the other types too).
- `witnessPoints` (array of CoordinateWitnessPoint): The witness points of the dimension. Besides the geometry each item carries the base element reference as CreateAssociativeDimensions takes it (API_Base: baseElementId, line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus, nodeId): read a dimension placed by hand to learn the values an element type needs.
- `linePen` (integer): The pen of the dimension and witness lines.
- `marker` (DimensionMarker): The marker at the witness points, always with its type, pen and size.
- `textPlacement` (DimensionTextPlacement): The text placement method of the dimension texts, always with all of its fields.
- `defaultWitnessForm` (string ("None", "Small", "Large", "Fix", "Unknown")): The witness line form of the dimension's settings (None, Small, Large or Fix); each witness point has its own witnessForm.
- `defaultWitnessVal` (number): The value that goes with defaultWitnessForm, in meters. For Fix it is the length of the witness lines (the custom witness line length of the Dimension Settings). Each witness point has its own witnessVal.
- `staticDimension` (boolean): The Static dimension checkbox of the Dimension Settings (API defStaticDim).
- `onlyDimensionText` (boolean): Whether only the dimension texts are shown, without the dimension and witness lines (API onlyDimensionText).
- `openingHeightsInChain` (boolean): Whether the opening heights are shown in the dimension chain (Dimension Details panel, API detailedHoleDim).
- `openingHeightsNominal` (boolean): Whether the opening heights are the nominal heights, without the oversize (API nominalHoleDim; false: with the oversize).
- `layeredElementDimensions` (LayeredElementDimensions)

### DimensionDataOrError

DimensionData or ErrorItem

### ConnectionItem

object: An element connected with its beginning or end point.
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)
- `connectedWithBeginPoint` (boolean, required): True if the element is connected with its beginning point, false if it is connected with its end point.

### EndpointConnections

object: The connections of a wall, beam or beam segment.
- `connectedToBeginPoint` (array of ConnectionItem, required): Elements connected to the beginning point of the element.
- `connectedToEndPoint` (array of ConnectionItem, required): Elements connected to the end point of the element.
- `connectedWithReferenceLineToEndPoints` (array of ConnectionItem, required): Elements connected with their reference line to the beginning or end point of the element.
- `connectedToReferenceLine` (array of ConnectionItem, required): Elements connected to the reference line of the element, not at its endpoints.
- `crossingReferenceLine` (array of ConnectionItem, required): Elements whose reference line intersects the reference line of the element.

### ElementsOfElementType

object: Elements of a given type.
- `elementType` (ElementType, required)
- `elements` (Elements, required)

### ZoneBoundaryPart

object: Section of a wall, beam or curtain wall segment related to a zone.
- `elementId` (ElementId, required)
- `roomEdgeIndex` (integer): Index of the zone polygon edge adjacent to the element (not present for beams).
- `begDistance` (number, required): Beginning distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.
- `endDistance` (number, required): End distance of the section from the beginning point of the element.

### ZoneRelations

object: The relations of a zone: the related elements grouped by type and the boundary sections of walls, beams and curtain wall segments.
- `elementsGroupedByType` (array of ElementsOfElementType, required): The elements related to the zone, grouped by element type.
- `wallParts` (array of ZoneBoundaryPart, required): Sections of walls that border the zone.
- `beamParts` (array of ZoneBoundaryPart, required): Sections of beams related to the zone.
- `curtainWallSegmentParts` (array of ZoneBoundaryPart, required): Sections of curtain wall segments that border the zone.

### ElementRelationsOrError

WallRelations or BeamRelations or BeamSegmentRelations or ZoneRelationsOfElement or OpeningRelationsOfElement or RoofOrShellRelationsOfElement or ErrorItem: The type-specific relations of an element or an error. The variant depends on the type of the input element.

### CoverFill

object: Floor plan cover fill settings of a Column or Beam.
- `use` (boolean, required): Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.
- `useFromSurface` (boolean, required): Whether the fill is taken from the top surface material of the element.
- `orientationComesFrom3D` (boolean, required): Whether the cover fill orientation comes from the 3D view of the element.
- `fillId` (AttributeId, required)
- `foregroundPen` (integer, required)
- `backgroundPen` (integer, required)
- `transformationType` (string ("Global", "Rotated", "Distorted"), required)
- `transformation` (CoverFillTransformation, required)

### CoverFillTransformation

object: Orientation and distortion parameters of a cover fill.
- `origin` (Coordinate2D, required): The origin of the fill relative to the center of the element.
- `xAxis` (Coordinate2D, required): Primary distortion (direction) vector.
- `yAxis` (Coordinate2D, required): Secondary distortion (direction) vector.

### FloorFill

object: Floor plan cover fill settings of a Slab. When modifying an element, omitted properties keep their current values.
- `use` (boolean): Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.
- `foregroundPen` (integer)
- `backgroundPen` (integer)
- `fillId` (AttributeId)
- `use3DHatching` (boolean): Use Vectorial 3D Hatch patterns in Floor Plan view, taken from the top side material.
- `orientation` (HatchOrientation): Orientation of the cover fill. On a Slab, Archicad applies only the type through the API: it resets the origin and the distortion matrix, so ModifySlabs reports a given origin or matrix that did not stick as a failure.

### ShellBaseFloorFill

object: Floor plan cover fill settings of a Roof or Shell (API_ShellBaseType).
- `use` (boolean): Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.
- `foregroundPen` (integer)
- `backgroundPen` (integer)
- `fillId` (AttributeId)
- `use3DHatching` (boolean): Use the fill of the surface material (Vectorial 3D Hatch) as the cover fill.
- `useFillLocBaseLine` (boolean): Align the cover fill with the pivot line instead of the fill handle.
- `useSlantedFill` (boolean): Distort the cover fill to show the slope as seen from above.
- `orientation` (HatchOrientation)

### MeshFloorFill

object: Floor plan cover fill settings of a Mesh (API_MeshType). When modifying a mesh, omitted properties keep their current values.
- `use` (boolean): Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.
- `foregroundPen` (integer)
- `backgroundPen` (integer)
- `fillId` (AttributeId)
- `useLocalOrigin` (boolean): Whether the cover fill is drawn from the mesh's own reference vector (localOrigin and angle) instead of the project origin.
- `localOrigin` (Coordinate2D): Base point of the cover fill's reference vector, used when useLocalOrigin is true.
- `angle` (number): Angle of the cover fill's reference vector in radians, used when useLocalOrigin is true.

### HatchFillCategory

string ("Drafting", "Cut", "Cover"): The fill category of a hatch (Fill Category of the Hatch Settings), which decides which Display Options settings the fill follows: Drafting fills, Cut fills or Cover fills.

### HatchOrientationType

string ("Global", "Rotated", "Distorted", "Centered")

### HatchOrientation

object: Orientation and distortion parameters of a fill. When modifying an element, omitted properties keep their current values.
- `type` (HatchOrientationType)
- `origin` (Coordinate2D): The origin of the fill relative to the project origin.
- `matrix00` (number): X component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.
- `matrix10` (number): Y component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.
- `matrix01` (number): X component of the secondary distortion vector.
- `matrix11` (number): Y component of the secondary distortion vector.
- `innerRadius` (number): Radius for circular fill distortion, used when type is Centered.

### OverriddenMaterial

object: A surface material that may override the one inherited from the element's structure (building material, composite or profile).
- `overridden` (boolean, required): True if the material is overridden on the element level.
- `attributeId` (AttributeId)

### OverriddenPen

object: A pen index that may override the one inherited from the element's structure. On Archicad versions where the underlying element does not support this override, 'overridden' is always false.
- `overridden` (boolean, required): True if the pen is overridden on the element level.
- `penIndex` (integer)

### TextRunDetails

object: One monostyle run of text (API_RunType). Concatenating 'text' across all runs in order gives the full content; a newline character starts a new line.
- `text` (string, required): The run's text content. Windows-style CRLF (and bare CR) line endings are normalized to LF.
- `penIndex` (integer): Pen attribute index. Optional; defaults to the style's penIndex.
- `fontIndex` (integer): Font attribute index. Optional; defaults to the style's fontIndex.
- `fontName` (string): Name of the font for this run only, resolved like the style's fontName (and taking precedence over the run's fontIndex). Optional; defaults to the style's font. Read back as the name of the font the run's fontIndex refers to, absent when no loaded font has that index.
- `bold` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's bold.
- `italic` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's italic.
- `underline` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's underline.
- `heightOverride` (number): Character height in mm for this run only. Optional; defaults to the style's height.
- `effectStrikeout` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectStrikeout.
- `effectSuperscript` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectSuperscript.
- `effectSubscript` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectSubscript.
- `effectProtected` (boolean): Optional; defaults to the style's effectProtected.

### TextStyleSettableDetails

object: Every user-configurable style setting of a Text or a text-class Label (API_TextType). Shared by CreateTexts/CreateLabels ('style'), ModifyTexts/ModifyLabels ('style'), and the Get response.
- `penIndex` (integer): Pen attribute index.
- `fontIndex` (integer): Font attribute index.
- `fontName` (string): Name of the font, as the Font attributes carry it and GetDetailsOfElements reports it in fontName, e.g. 'Arial'. Resolved to the font's index (exact match first, then case-insensitive); the command fails when no loaded font has the name. Takes precedence over fontIndex if both are given.
- `bold` (boolean)
- `italic` (boolean)
- `underline` (boolean)
- `justification` (Justification)
- `height` (number): Character height in mm.
- `spacing` (number): Line spacing factor, between -10.0 and -1.0.
- `angle` (number): Rotation angle in radians.
- `effectStrikeout` (boolean)
- `effectSuperscript` (boolean)
- `effectSubscript` (boolean)
- `effectProtected` (boolean): Protected text (autotext reference).
- `widthFactor` (number): Width scale of the text, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `charSpaceFactor` (number): Character spacing scale, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `fixedSize` (boolean): Size does not depend on output scale.
- `usedContour` (boolean): Draw the frame of the text block.
- `usedFill` (boolean): Draw a solid fill behind the text block.
- `contourPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's frame.
- `fillPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's background fill.
- `anchor` (TextBoxAnchor)
- `fixedAngle` (boolean): The rotation angle does not change when the element is rotated.
- `contourOffset` (number): Offset of the frame/background fill from the text bounding box, in mm.
- `flipEnabled` (boolean): The text should always be readable (flips when viewed upside down).
- `textFrameShape` (string ("Rectangle", "Circle", "RoundedRectangle", "Pill")): Text frame shape. Standalone Text elements only support Rectangle. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as Rectangle.
- `textFrameSizeFixed` (boolean): Use fixedWidth/fixedHeight instead of fitting the frame to the text box. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as false.
- `textFrameFixedWidth` (number): Frame width in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true. Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.
- `textFrameFixedHeight` (number): Frame height in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true (ignored for Circle, which uses fixedWidth as diameter). Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.

### TextStyleDetails

object: Full readable style state of a Text or text-class Label: every field of TextStyleSettableDetails plus the read-only ones (lineCount, boxWidth, boxHeight, and nonBreaking for a standalone Text).
- `penIndex` (integer): Pen attribute index.
- `fontIndex` (integer): Font attribute index.
- `fontName` (string): The name of the font fontIndex refers to, as the Font attributes carry it. Absent when no loaded font has that index.
- `bold` (boolean)
- `italic` (boolean)
- `underline` (boolean)
- `justification` (Justification)
- `height` (number): Character height in mm.
- `spacing` (number): Line spacing factor, between -10.0 and -1.0.
- `angle` (number): Rotation angle in radians.
- `effectStrikeout` (boolean)
- `effectSuperscript` (boolean)
- `effectSubscript` (boolean)
- `effectProtected` (boolean): Protected text (autotext reference).
- `widthFactor` (number): Width scale of the text, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `charSpaceFactor` (number): Character spacing scale, between 0.75 and 10.0.
- `fixedSize` (boolean): Size does not depend on output scale.
- `usedContour` (boolean): Draw the frame of the text block.
- `usedFill` (boolean): Draw a solid fill behind the text block.
- `contourPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's frame.
- `fillPenIndex` (integer): Pen index of the text block's background fill.
- `anchor` (TextBoxAnchor)
- `fixedAngle` (boolean): The rotation angle does not change when the element is rotated.
- `contourOffset` (number): Offset of the frame/background fill from the text bounding box, in mm.
- `flipEnabled` (boolean): The text should always be readable (flips when viewed upside down).
- `textFrameShape` (string ("Rectangle", "Circle", "RoundedRectangle", "Pill")): Text frame shape. Standalone Text elements only support Rectangle. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as Rectangle.
- `textFrameSizeFixed` (boolean): Use fixedWidth/fixedHeight instead of fitting the frame to the text box. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as false.
- `textFrameFixedWidth` (number): Frame width in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true. Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.
- `textFrameFixedHeight` (number): Frame height in mm, when textFrameSizeFixed is true (ignored for Circle, which uses fixedWidth as diameter). Between 1 and 1000. Available from Archicad 28; earlier versions ignore it and read it back as 0.
- `lineCount` (integer): Read-only: number of text lines (API_TextType::nLine).
- `boxWidth` (number): Read-only here: horizontal size of the text box in mm. For a Text with word wrap on (nonBreaking false) the wrap width, as CreateTexts and ModifyTexts set it with width; otherwise auto-computed by Archicad from the content.
- `boxHeight` (number): Read-only: vertical size of the text box in mm, auto-computed by Archicad.
- `nonBreaking` (boolean): Read-only here, standalone Texts only: true when word wrap is off ('Wrap Text' turned off), so the text box grows with the content; false when the text wraps within boxWidth. CreateTexts and ModifyTexts set it to false with their width.

### LabelLeaderLineSettableDetails

object: Every user-configurable leader-line/frame/arrow setting of a Label (top-level API_LabelType fields, shared by both Text and Symbol label classes). Shared by CreateLabels ('leaderLine'), ModifyLabels ('leaderLine'), and the Get response.

- `arrowVisible` (boolean)
- `arrowPenIndex` (integer)
- `arrowSize` (number): Arrow size in mm.

- `hasLeaderLine` (boolean): Whether the Label has a leader line (pointer line).
- `anchorPoint` (LabelLeaderLineAnchorPoint): Only applies to text-class labels.
- `leaderShape` (string ("Segmented", "Splinear", "SquareRoot")): Shape of the leader line.

### LabelArrowType

### LabelSymbolStyleSettableDetails

object: Every user-configurable style setting specific to a Symbol-class Label (top-level API_LabelType fields documented as 'for symbol labels only'). Shared by CreateLabels ('symbolStyle'), ModifyLabels ('symbolStyle'), and the Get response.

On input resolved to the font's index like a Text style's fontName, taking precedence over fontIndex, and failing when no loaded font has the name; on read-back the name of the font fontIndex refers to, absent when no loaded font has that index.

- `italic` (boolean)
- `underline` (boolean)
